summary: CAIR Action, which weighs civil-rights and foreign-policy positions including Gaza and ceasefire stances in its recommendations, listed Mer Curry Nuñez as a preferred candidate for the East Side Union High School District Trustee Area 1 seat. Activist Samir Laymoun separately supported Nuñez, though his recommendation is an opinion source and does not by itself establish shared policy views.
